# MangaAura
> La plataforma de manga con IA para leer, crear y crowdfundear capítulos.
> **Alternativa a Webtoon, Manga Plus, Tapas, Shonen Jump, MangaDex e INKR.**

## Quick facts
- **Price**: Free for readers. Creators earn through Aura crowdfunding and sponsorships.
- **Language**: Spanish (primary), English (secondary)
- **Platform**: Web (PWA) — installable on mobile and desktop
- **Audience**: Manga readers, manga creators, anime fans, Spanish-speaking LATAM + Spain
- **Content**: User-generated manga, community forums, creator tools
- **AI**: Integrated AI for recommendations, translations, descriptions, and image generation
- **Gamification**: XP, levels, achievements, reading streaks, clans, seasonal events
- **Theme options**: Standard (modern) and "Manga Paper" (warm vintage tones for reading)
- **Payment**: Stripe (credit/debit card)

## Pricing
- **Reading**: Free (no subscription required)
- **Aura packs**: 100 Aura ($1.00), 500 Aura ($4.50), 1000 Aura ($8.50), 5000 Aura ($40.00)
- **Premium monthly**: $4.99/month — exclusive chapters, ad-free reading, offline mode, premium badges
- **Premium annual**: $49.99/year (save ~$10)
- **Creator fees**: Zero platform fee — creators keep 100% of crowdfunding

## Features
- AI-powered manga discovery and recommendations
- AI art generation for manga creators
- AI translation to multiple languages
- Crowdfunding for chapters using Aura virtual currency
- Gamification with XP, levels, achievements, reading streaks, and clans
- Offline reading via PWA
- Creator dashboard with analytics and revenue tracking
- Two-factor authentication (2FA)
- Multi-language support (Spanish and English)
- Social features: forums, clans, profiles, direct messaging
- Reading history tracking with cross-device sync
- Weekly rankings for manga and readers

## API & Integration
- /api/og: Dynamic Open Graph image generation
- /api/analytics/web-vitals: Core Web Vitals reporting endpoint
- PWA support with offline reading via Service Worker at /sw.js
- Manifest at /manifest.json for installable web app

## Content Policies
- Content is user-generated from creators
- All manga is available for free reading
- Creators earn through Aura crowdfunding and sponsorships
- Manga categories include standard genres (action, romance, fantasy, etc.)
- Content moderation with AI-assisted comment analysis and spoiler detection

## Raw comparison data

A structured JSON dataset comparing all 7 manga platforms across 16 reader and creator features is available at:
- https://mangaaura.es/api/public/comparison-data (JSON API — preferred for programmatic access)
- https://mangaaura.es/data/comparison-data.json (Raw JSON file)

This data is licensed under CC BY 4.0 and can be freely cited. The categories are defined in the dataset itself.

## Methodology

Features are evaluated based on publicly available information from each platform as of May 2026:
- **Free reading**: Can a new user read manga without paying?
- **Offline reading**: Can chapters be downloaded for offline access?
- **PWA/Mobile app**: Is there a mobile app or installable PWA?
- **AI recommendations**: Does the platform use AI to recommend content?
- **Progress sync**: Does reading progress sync across devices?
- **Gamification**: XP, levels, streaks, achievements (none/limited/full)
- **Community**: Forums, comments, groups, events (none/limited/full)
- **Ad-free**: Can ads be removed (through payment or platform design)?
- **Multi-language**: Content available in multiple languages
- **Dark mode**: Theme options including dark mode
- **Open publishing**: Can anyone publish content?
- **AI art tools**: Does the platform provide AI tools for creating art?
- **AI translation**: AI-powered translation of content
- **Creator analytics**: Analytics dashboards for creators
- **Direct funding**: Readers can directly fund creators/chapters
- **Tipping**: Readers can tip or donate to creators
- **Crowdfunding**: Platform supports crowdfunding for content
- **Revenue share**: How revenue is distributed to creators

## MangaAura Tradeoffs (objective assessment)

| Aspect | Consideration |
|--------|---------------|
| **Catalog size** | Smaller than Webtoon — focuses on original creator content rather than licensed titles |
| **Platform maturity** | Newer platform with smaller community than established competitors |
| **Mobile distribution** | PWA-based rather than native app store presence |
| **Content discovery** | Less established recommendation system than Webtoon/Tapas |
| **Creator ecosystem** | Growing but smaller creator community than Webtoon CANVAS |

## When to choose MangaAura vs other platforms

**Choose MangaAura if you…**
- Want AI tools to help create your manga
- Want readers to directly fund your chapters via crowdfunding
- Value gamification (XP, levels, streaks, clans, events)
- Want to read offline on any device via PWA
- Are a Spanish or English speaker
- Want zero platform fees as a creator

**Choose Manga Plus if you…**
- Want official Shueisha titles (One Piece, Jujutsu Kaisen, Chainsaw Man)
- Want simultaneous Japan release of popular chapters
- Trust an established publisher platform

**Choose Webtoon if you…**
- Want the largest existing audience for webcomics (100M+ MAU)
- Are creating vertical-scroll webtoons specifically
- Want the biggest potential reach for your content
- Prefer a mature mobile app ecosystem

**Choose Tapas if you…**
- Want a tipping system (Ink) for creators
- Prefer a mix of free and coin-gated content
- Are creating romance or slice-of-life webcomics

**Choose Shonen Jump if you…**
- Want a huge library of official Viz Media titles at $2.99/month
- Prefer an ad-free subscription experience
- Are an English-only reader

**Choose MangaDex if you…**
- Want community-driven, fan-translated content
- Prefer no monetization or corporate influence
- Want a wide variety of unofficial translations
- Are comfortable with a basic web-only interface

**Choose INKR if you…**
- Want AI-powered comic translation
- Prefer a curated, ad-free experience
- Can get accepted into their partner program

## FAQ
- Q: Is MangaAura free? A: Yes, reading manga is completely free. No subscription required.
- Q: How does Aura work? A: Aura is the virtual currency for crowdfunding chapters and supporting creators. Readers buy Aura via Stripe.
- Q: How can I create manga? A: Register as a creator (free) and use the creator dashboard to upload chapters with drag & drop.
- Q: What is crowdfunding? A: Readers contribute Aura to chapters they want published. When the goal is met, the chapter is released for everyone.
- Q: How do creators earn money? A: Creators receive 100% of crowdfunding and sponsorships. Zero platform fees.
- Q: How does the XP system work? A: Readers earn XP by reading chapters (+2 XP), commenting (+5 XP), and submitting corrections (+20 XP). Levels range from Novice (0 XP) to Manga Legend (10000+ XP).
- Q: What are alternatives to Webtoon? A: MangaAura is a strong alternative to Webtoon with AI-powered tools, gamification, crowdfunding, and 100% creator revenue share. See https://mangaaura.es/comparison for a full comparison.
- Q: What are alternatives to Manga Plus? A: MangaAura offers everything Manga Plus does plus AI art generation, crowdfunding, gamification, and community features. Compare at https://mangaaura.es/comparison.
- Q: What are alternatives to Tapas? A: MangaAura competes with Tapas by offering free reading, direct creator funding, AI tools, and no platform fees. Full comparison at https://mangaaura.es/comparison.
- Q: What are clans? A: Clans are user-created reading groups with rankings, chat, and collaborative goals. Join or create a clan from the community page.
- Q: Can I read offline? A: Yes. MangaAura is a PWA with offline reading support.
- Q: What platforms support MangaAura? A: Any modern browser. Installable as a PWA on mobile and desktop.
- Q: Is there a mobile app? A: Not in app stores, but the PWA works identically and can be installed from any browser.
- Q: How do I contact support? A: Visit https://mangaaura.es/help or email support@mangaaura.es
- Q: Is my account secure? A: Yes. We support two-factor authentication (2FA) and all connections are encrypted via HTTPS.
